description: This file defines API routes for managing dashboards within a web application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting dashboards, utilizing FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy for database interactions. It also incorporates real-time notifications via a manager component.

methods.description: Checks if the specified workspace exists within the organization, raising a 404 error if not.
